title: Proof run passed
statement: A proof run passed when its attestation is verified and every test record whose state is automated in the spec at its commit has an outcome of passed.

title: Attestation is verified
statement: An attestation is verified when the provider returns it for exactly the commit asked about, its signer is the provider's trusted signer, and its predicate type is the one STEGO owns for that statement.

title: No obligation falls
statement: A change holds the ratchet when every obligation that lathe counts as designed, built or proved at the base branch's head is still counted so at the change's commit; a new obligation may arrive undesigned, unbuilt or unproved, so the spec can grow before its code.

title: Release is fully proved
statement: A commit is fully proved for release when its designed, built and proved shares are each 100% and a proof run at that commit passed.

title: Build record is trusted
statement: A build record is trusted when the digest of its canonical bytes equals a digest that verified provenance supplies.

title: Image signature is acceptable
statement: An image signature is acceptable when it is in the transparency log or made by a trusted key, and its signer identity is the trusted signer the service's delivery pipeline names for the provider that built the image.

title: Default left without a reason
statement: A declaration satisfies it when it says tenancy kind single or audit off and gives no reason.

title: Tenant comes from a client field
statement: A declaration satisfies it when its tenancy claim names a request header or a body field instead of a path in the verified identity token.

title: Tenant-less path declared
statement: A declaration satisfies it when a controller declares tenants none, a collection reads a system entity, or a binding that runs as tenant writes a shared entity.

title: Audit level or sensitivity unknown
statement: A declaration satisfies it when an audit level is not metadata or change, an audit sink is not a port binding, or a field sensitivity is not public, pii or secret.

title: Schema lacks a named permission
statement: A declaration satisfies it when an entity, a collection or a slot names a resource type, a permission, a relation or a caveat parameter that the compiled .zed schema does not declare.

title: Slot relationship unknown to the schema
statement: A declaration satisfies it when a slot binding lists a relation in Relationships written that the schema lacks or that belongs to no resource type of a declared entity.

title: Bypass flag present
statement: A declaration satisfies it when any slot binding or component setting holds a bypass flag.

title: Idempotency required on an ignored method
statement: A declaration satisfies it when Required on names read, list, delete or another operation that GET, PUT or DELETE serves.

title: Money field is a float
statement: A declaration satisfies it when a field that holds money is typed as a float or a decimal instead of integer minor units with a currency.

title: Ledger currency is not one ISO 4217 code
statement: A declaration satisfies it when a ledger has no currency, a currency that is not an ISO 4217 code, or an account minimum balance in another currency.

title: Ledger collection allows update or delete
statement: A declaration satisfies it when a collection over a ledger names update or delete among its operations.

title: Balance column writable by a slot
statement: A declaration satisfies it when a slot binding on a ledger account collection can update a balance column.

title: Transfer has one entry
statement: A declaration satisfies it when a transfer code or a transfer example states one entry, so the set cannot balance.

title: Mode unknown
statement: A declaration satisfies it when Modes names a mode other than api, worker or controller.

title: Mixin requirement unmet
statement: A declaration satisfies it when it binds kafka-events without durable-events.

title: Invariant has no known emission
statement: A declaration satisfies it when a declared invariant has a kind other than unique, no_overlap or sum_limit, or lacks the fields its kind needs.

title: Controller lacks a lease
statement: A declaration satisfies it when a controller has no lease TTL, a source other than scan or watch, or tenants other than each.

title: Digest is superseded
statement: A component digest is superseded when its lifecycle holds a supersession.

title: Digest is past its fail date
statement: A component digest is past its fail date when its lifecycle holds a supersession or a withdrawal, and the date after which it fails has passed.

title: Digest is withdrawn
statement: A component digest is withdrawn when its lifecycle holds a withdrawal, whatever the date of the withdrawal.

title: Requirement is met
statement: A platform requirement is met when the environment file supplies, under its name, a value of its kind with every part its shape names, such as each key of a secret or the port of an egress endpoint.

title: Reference is pinned
statement: A pipeline reference is pinned when it names a full 40-character commit SHA or a sha256 OCI digest.

title: Fill is qualified
statement: A fill is qualified when its evidence names its current content digest and its slot contract's current digest, and a key in the project's SIGNERS file signed that evidence.

title: Fill fits its binding
statement: A fill fits a slot binding when it implements the bound slot and serves the bound collection.

title: Generated file is hand-edited
statement: A generated file is hand-edited when the file on disk is missing or no longer matches the hash its record holds.

title: Component fit for a golden path
statement: A component is fit for a golden path when its stage is ga. An archetype or a mixin MUST NOT include a component that is not.

title: Port has one provider
statement: A port has one provider when exactly one component of the active component set provides it. Each port MUST have one provider in the active set.

title: Every required port is answered
statement: An active component set answers its ports when every port that a component of the set requires has a provider in that set.

title: Component past its sunset
statement: A component is past its sunset when its stage is alpha or beta and its sunset date is earlier than today.

title: Component states its place
statement: A component states its place when it names one layer, its part in a request flow, and a side for each port it provides or requires.

title: Emitted file is static
statement: A file a component emits is static when rendering the component for two declarations that differ in every input the component reads gives the same bytes, once the module path and package name are normalised.

title: Contract set is best of breed
statement: A component's contract set is best of breed when a reference comparison recorded at the set's current digest names at least one best-in-field reference, or states why none exists, and leaves no promise of a reference neither adopted as a contract nor declined with a reason.
